sources.title: loom-fun/unsloth-Muse-Glimmer-30B-loom · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A Loom package (.loom programs and a model.json card) for the unmodified GGUF checkpoint unsloth/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF (Muse-Glimmer-30B-UD-Q5_K_M.gguf), generated on an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 "Strix Halo" with the loom-skills workflow. Image input comes from a vision projector: send OpenAI-style image_url parts.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model | Research - AI at Meta
sources.snippet: The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer - Meta AI
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer An open model built for always-on local agents. 30B parameters, licensed under Apache 2.0 and runs on a single GPU — tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.
